sms_citizen.body: Your application $$APPL_NUMBER$$ has been successfully submitted online. It will be inspected by $$OFFICER_NAME$$($$OFFICER_MOBILE$$). You can find the status of your application by logging into the Portal from time to time.
sms_citizen.body_query: select A.APPL_NUMBER, U.USER_NAME OFFICER_NAME, U.MOBILE OFFICER_MOBILE from noc_applications A inner join noc_process P on P.APPL_ID = A.APPL_ID and P.DELETED = 0 and P.END_DATE is null and P.ACTION_ like '%Inspection%' inner join noc_users U on U.DELETED = 0 and U.USER_ID = P.USER_ID where A.DELETED  = 0 and A.APPL_ID = @OBJECT_ID
sms_citizen.to_query: select C.MOBILE from noc_applications A inner join noc_citizens C on C.CITIZEN_ID = A.CITIZEN_ID and C.DELETED = 0 where A.DELETED  = 0 and A.APPL_ID = @OBJECT_ID

sms_officers.body:
Application : $$APPL_NUMBER$$ for $$SITE_NAME$$ has been submitted.
 Please review, inspect and submit remarks
sms_officers.body_query: select A.APPL_NUMBER, A.SITE_NAME from noc_applications A where A.DELETED  = 0 and A.APPL_ID = @OBJECT_ID
sms_officers.to_query: select MOBILE from noc_process P inner join noc_users U on U.USER_ID = P.USER_ID and U.DELETED = 0 where P.APPL_ID = @OBJECT_ID and P.DELETED = 0
